title: RFC 9457 — 400 Bad Request
description: Validates the RFC 9457 Problem Details structure for 400 Bad Request responses. All five fields (type, title, status, detail, instance) are required. Can be reused by any test case that expects a 400 error response.

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem

status.description: HTTP status code — must be 400 in the body (AC4)

instance.description: URI reference / request path that identifies this occurrence (AC5)
